verdict.rationale: The docs show fiat/stablecoin conversion inside CDP's custodial accounts. Liquidation deposit destinations auto-convert incoming funds into another asset before crediting the account, and documented CLI/SDK guides cover accepting USDC with auto-conversion to a USD treasury and funding a USD treasury to pay out USDC. Transfers come with fee quotes and lifecycle tracking. However, these conversions are tied to deposit and payout flows. Nothing shows an on-demand internal transfer or rebalancing operation between fiat and stablecoin balances, and dashboard support is unevidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit internal transfer/rebalance API between fiat and stablecoin balances, dashboard-based rebalancing, end-to-end treasury rebalancing documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
